sources.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro — March 18, 2026 launch
sources.evidence: Names the model and developer; states total parameters surpass 1T, 42B active, hybrid attention at 7:1, MTP, 1M context, reasoning and tool use. Identifies Hunter Alpha, publicly tested one week earlier, as an early internal test build of V2-Pro, with further iteration before the named launch. Offers API access.

sources.title: Model Release — 2026-03-18 mimo-v2-pro
sources.evidence: The dated V2-Pro entry rounds total parameters to 1T, lists 42B active and 1M context, and explicitly defines the attention ratio as one global-attention layer to seven sliding-window-attention layers.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro — Full benchmark results with MiMo-V2-Pro comparison column
sources.evidence: The browser-rendered Full benchmark results table has a separate header explicitly labeled MiMo-V2-Pro, 1.02T / 42B. The published HTML maps the mimov2pro column to those counts and renders it into fullbench-table. This is a later disclosure of the exact predecessor, not transfer of the adjacent V2.5-Pro specification. The open-source download table links only V2.5-Pro and V2.5-Pro-Base; its benchmark styling code also sets V2-Pro os:true, which is not a checkpoint publication or license grant.

sources.title: OpenRouter exact MiMo-V2-Pro model endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct public JSON retrieval identifies xiaomi/mimo-v2-pro and reports modality text->text, input_modalities [text], output_modalities [text]. Its endpoints array is currently empty, so this is retained model metadata, not evidence of a working endpoint.

sources.title: MiMo-V2-Pro provider model page
sources.evidence: The complete indexed provider page identifies xiaomi/mimo-v2-pro, dates the named release March 18, 2026, and explicitly reports a 1,048,576-token context window. The page was crawled within the preceding month; its historical model specifications do not establish current service availability.

sources.title: Hunter Alpha — early testing version of MiMo-V2-Pro
sources.evidence: The complete indexed provider page explicitly maps Hunter Alpha to an early testing version of MiMo-V2-Pro and gives March 11, 2026 as its public release date. Xiaomi independently confirms this identity in its launch. Preview modality claims are not transferred to the later named API model.

sources.title: XiaomiMiMo official public model inventory
sources.evidence: Direct current API retrieval returned 30 XiaomiMiMo repositories, including V2-Flash and the V2.5/V2.6 releases, with no exact MiMo-V2-Pro checkpoint. This corroborates the original hosted distribution; it is not an assertion that every possible repository was searched.

sources.title: Official MiMo-V2.5-Pro model card
sources.evidence: The later card explicitly describes V2.5-Pro with 1.02T/42B, MoE, MIT licensing and a 6:1 attention ratio. Those architectural details, weights and license belong to V2.5-Pro; the original V2-Pro specifies 7:1. The predecessor count is supported separately by the exact V2-Pro column in s3.

sources.title: Model Deprecation — June 30, 2026
sources.evidence: States that requests using mimo-v2-pro were routed to mimo-v2.5-pro from June 1, 2026, and that the old model ID expired June 30. Later replacement models and current aliases cannot establish the original model specifications.

sources.title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
sources.evidence: Checked this later first-party technical paper for an exact V2-Pro architecture or size disclosure. Its model experiments concern Qwen3-30B-A3B and MiMo-V2-Flash; it provides no exact V2-Pro specification to transfer.

sources.title: Fuli Luo original MiMo-V2-Pro launch post
sources.evidence: The original researcher post was located, but direct access returned HTTP 403. Reproductions were only discovery leads and were not used as the basis for technical claims.

sources.title: Xiaomi MiMo user agreement
sources.evidence: The link returned an application shell without the agreement text. No particular contractual permission or restriction is inferred from this failed retrieval.

sources.title: Xiaomi MiMo service agreement document content
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved official document chunk mapped to quick-start/terms/user-agreement. English section 5.1 retains ownership and intellectual property in model parameters, algorithms, code and framework. Current agreement supports descriptive hosted-model proprietary classification, not launch-period contractual detail.

sources.title: Fuli Luo original launch post via X syndication
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved original post timestamp March 18,2026 21:22:33 UTC and opening announcement explicitly naming MiMo-V2-Pro, Omni and TTS. Syndication truncates the long post; no parameter or topology claim inferred from unavailable remainder.

name.note: Exact Xiaomi release name; retain capitalization.

developer.note: Released by the Xiaomi MiMo team.

family.note: Normalized family name for the Xiaomi MiMo series.

release_date.note: Earliest documented public preview: OpenRouter dates Hunter Alpha March 11 and both provider and Xiaomi identify it as an early V2-Pro test build. The finalized named API launch was March 18. Counts and modalities below describe the named V2-Pro model, not every preview revision.

open_weights.note: The exact V2-Pro was distributed as a hosted model, and no exact weights publication appears in Xiaomi’s current official inventory. V2.5-Pro is a separate open-weight successor. An os:true benchmark styling flag in s3 is not enough to claim a downloadable original checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the original hosted, non-open-weight model. Current Xiaomi service terms reserve model IP; this is not a named SPDX license or a claim about launch-period contract terms. The successor MIT grant is not transferred.

parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal 1.02T = 1020B from the later first-party comparison column explicitly labeled MiMo-V2-Pro, verified in the rendered table. Consistent with the original >1T disclosure and more precise than the changelog’s rounded 1T. This is not an exact learned-tensor count; no original checkpoint/config was available and no weights were downloaded.

active_parameters_b.note: Xiaomi’s nominal 42B active count, reported directly for V2-Pro at launch and repeated in its separately labeled later comparison column. No exact component-level accounting is claimed.

architecture.note: The verified description is hybrid sliding-window/global attention at 7:1 with a lightweight MTP layer. Primary material reviewed does not provide an exact V2-Pro MoE routing/configuration disclosure; the successor’s MoE type, expert counts, layer counts and 6:1 ratio are not transferred. Use the supported descriptive architecture rather than infer a stronger subtype.

context_window.note: Xiaomi states 1M; the exact V2-Pro provider page specifies 1,048,576 tokens. This is the last-documented limit for the original hosted model, not confirmation that its deprecated endpoint operates today.

modalities.note: Exact original-model provider metadata explicitly says text->text. Do not add image/audio from Hunter Alpha metadata, V2-Omni, or later models reached through alias replacement.

reasoning.note: Xiaomi explicitly describes multi-step reasoning and evaluates the exact model on reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Original announcement directly documents tool use and training on agent workflows; later exact-model comparisons include tool-use tasks.

description.value: Xiaomi text model for reasoning, coding and tool use, with hybrid attention and a 1M-token context window.
description.note: Replaces the unsupported multimodal wording with the documented text-model scope and concrete capabilities.

patch.description: Xiaomi text model for reasoning, coding and tool use, with hybrid attention and a 1M-token context window.
patch.notes: Release date is the March 11, 2026 public Hunter Alpha preview, explicitly identified by Xiaomi and OpenRouter as an early MiMo-V2-Pro build; the named API launch followed March 18. Parameters are Xiaomi’s nominal 1.02T/42B from a later comparison column explicitly labeled MiMo-V2-Pro, consistent with the original >1T/42B disclosure; they are not exact tensor counts. The original uses 7:1 sliding-window/global attention and text input/output. V2.5-Pro’s architecture, MIT license and open weights are not transferred. Xiaomi routed the old API name to V2.5-Pro June 1 and deprecated it June 30, 2026.

OpenRouter Hunter Alpha preview release and identity

summary: Confirmed all 14 public fields. Corrected earliest release to the linked March 11 preview, removed unsupported multimodal description, and added Xiaomi’s later explicitly labeled nominal 1020B total/42B active disclosure. Recorded the directly supported hybrid-attention architecture without inventing an exact MoE subtype. Retained text-only scope and 1,048,576 context from exact provider metadata; retained closed weights and classified hosted distribution as proprietary. Exact learned-tensor count and detailed V2-Pro routing configuration remain undisclosed in the reviewed primary sources; successor specifications are not transferred.
